program_model.instance_model: same dimensional logo + tagline in two substrate families across locations

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A flush stud-mounted dimensional reception logo and tagline: flat-cut 1/2in acrylic painted to brand colors at reception, or flat-cut 1/2in anodized-black brushed aluminum at the elevator lobby.
knowledge.rationale: Two substrate families (painted acrylic vs anodized aluminum) carry the same logo across locations; flush stud + VHB + silicone is the clean mount.

structure.construction: flat-cut 1/2in acrylic logo painted PMS 300C/144C + 1/4in acrylic tagline PMS 424C; variant flat-cut 1/2in aluminum vertical brushed grain anodized black, masked/painted PMS 424C

craft_observations: Two substrate families for one logo across locations is a deliberate variant, not a new type.
